name: PWN
description: PWN is a non-custodial, peer-to-peer permissionless lending protocol. In the true spirit of DeFi composability, PWN users can borrow against (or lend using) any asset in their wallet (ERC-20, NFT, and even a bundle of both), while enjoying absolute flexibility on the loan terms (LTV, duration, APY, etc.). The oracle-less nature of the protocol protects all PWN loans from price-based liquidations. The only way to lose collateral is to default on a loan. Operating on 7 EVM-compatible networks, PWN opens up new liquidity avenues, composability options, and leverage opportunities, while giving its users both optimized capital efficiency and predictability on both sides of the loan.

name: Primex Finance
description: Primex Finance is a non-custodial prime brokerage protocol that connects lenders with traders, enabling traders to utilize lender liquidity for leveraged spot trading on existing DEXs like Uniswap, Balancer, Curve, and more. On Primex, traders can also benefit from CEX-like trader tooling and interfaces. The protocol is powered by the fully decentralized trade execution mechanism (community-hosted Keepers), enabling the execution of different types of limit orders in a decentralized manner. In the next versions, Primex has plans to expand its feature set to include other leveraged operations across various DeFi protocols, such as lending, providing liquidity on AMM-based DEXs, etc.

name: Aquarius Loan

name: Hermes V2

name: Seneca
description: Seneca is an omnichain CDP protocol for yield-bearing assets. Borrow collateralized stablecoin senUSD using supported collateral. SEN token utility includes governance, trading tax redistribution, and protocol fee redistribution through staking. Seneca users can access institutional-grade borrowing against established and developing DeFi assets, maximising capital efficiency. Seneca is Arbitrum native.
